2026 Fall Intern, Digital Health Algorithms
665 Clyde Avenue, Mountain View, CA, USA

Lab Summary:

Samsung Research America Digital Health Algorithms Team (https://www.sra.samsung.com/digital-health/) collaborates with top universities, hospitals, and healthcare-industry partners to collect large-scale data and develop novel AI/ML algorithms to transform how healthcare is delivered. We use design thinking to address some of healthcare’s toughest challenges, from improving care and producing better outcomes, to reducing costs and expanding access.

Focusing on wearable, mobile, and cloud-based form factors, our multi-disciplinary team develops innovative technologies that we then turn into groundbreaking commercial products to support clinicians, patients, and consumers. We use advanced sensor technology to capture physiologic responses and make use of our AI/ML framework to build algorithms for developing digital biomarkers and digital interventions. We employ data analytics to supplement clinical care and facilitate remote patient monitoring, thereby helping patients make behavioral changes that improve their health and daily lives. Our work has been internationally recognized with 70+ peer-reviewed publications and 10 design awards.

Our portfolio of digital health algorithmic solutions are important tools in helping clinicians and their patients monitor and manage serious health conditions, such as cardiovascular disease, pulmonary disease, and cancer; as wells chronic illnesses including mental health, diabetes, hypertension, depression, sleep disorders, and obesity. Our work encompasses the entire range of processes, from ideating, developing, and incubating; to designing and delivering market-ready products; to supporting and evolving currently released products.

Position Summary:

We are looking for Ph.D. candidates with solid ML/AI/GenAI technology background and digital health-related research project experiences in multi-modal physiological health algorithm development, large-scale wearable data analytics, and physiological signal processing. By leveraging smartphones, wearables, and hearables in health/wellness domain, your work will significantly benefit real-world consumers, patients, the elderly, physicians, and caregivers.

Samsung’s unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on digital health will provide you with unprecedented large data sets and healthcare analytics challenges.

Position Responsibilities:

You will work with an experienced digital health algorithm research team to develop novel and disruptive algorithms towards digital health services and solutions.
Design, implement, and optimize advanced AI models, including self-supervised learning, for health applications.
Work with large-scale time-series datasets to train and fine-tune ML/DL models using AWS AI services, ensuring scalability and efficiency.
Contribute to the development of novel AI methodologies to address complex healthcare challenges.

Required Skills:

Currently pursuing PhD degree in computer science, electrical engineering, biomedical engineering or related areas
Solid coding skills with prototyping experience in AI model development, data science, and machine learning
Experience in physiological signal processing, large-scale time-series data analytics in digital health domain
Strong knowledge and experience in developing AI/ML foundation models and their finetuning approaches
Programming using languages such as Python, R, C/C++, Java, Android
Experience with cloud infra services like AWS, SageMaker Studio, GCP, SQL, and collaboration tools like github
Good communication/presentation skills and teamwork/collaboration spirit
Publication in top-tier journals and conferences

This position is open to candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States.

Hourly Pay Rate Range

$44 - $63 USD
